name: Thomas J. Ryan
occupation: Hot Springs County commissioner (serving through the current term, which ends in January 2027)
prior_offices: Hot Springs County commissioner (won the November 2022 general election; listed as Tom Ryan on the official commissioners page)
background: Thomas J. Ryan, also listed as Tom Ryan, is a Hot Springs County commissioner, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. He won the November 2022 general election, and the official commissioners page lists him as a member. Incoming commissioner Phillip Scheel takes office in January 2027.
